title: The fire triangle
description: An original animated explainer. Dry firewood holds about 4 kWh of heat per kilogram, and fire is how we let it out. A fire needs heat, fuel and oxygen: take away any one and it goes out. Building a fire from tinder up through spaghetti-thin, finger-thick and wrist-thick sticks, why dry wood matters (Ready to Burn: 20% moisture or less), how a fire steel makes sparks, and the safety rules: never a fire or barbecue in a tent, the Countryside Code, and drown, stir, drown again, check it's cold.
